notes.title: Play Mystery Goal Three!
notes.notes:
New Features in Update 0.650

Play Goal Three:
Accuse! Hypnotize a suspect for clues
Charm! Your way into a society wedding
Meddle! Matchmake or cause havoc
Interfere! Family business hijinks
Collect! More Village Friends toys
SOLVE! New newspaper mysteries each day

This update includes:
- Goal Three, a new mystery in the main storyline
- Enhancements to NPCs hosting and attending parties
- Updates for the courtroom interface
- Improved NPC pathfinding
- Gameplay and graphics corrections

Chat and share comments at the [url=https://discord.com/invite/2AdXwwh4Ye]Discord[/url]

Connect with #GrandFirVillage at your [url=https://linktr.ee/grandfirvillage]favorite media[/url]
See you there!
